In [6]:
import cv2
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

# folder with your images
folder_path = "C:/Users/user/Downloads/project/images"

# get all image files
image_files = os.listdir(folder_path)

for file in image_files:
    image_path = os.path.join(folder_path, file)

    image = cv2.imread(image_path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)

    if image is None:
        continue

    # Resize
    resized = cv2.resize(image, (256, 256))

    # Histogram Equalization
    hist_eq = cv2.equalizeHist(resized)

    # CLAHE
    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    clahe_img = clahe.apply(resized)

    # Gaussian Blur
    gaussian = cv2.GaussianBlur(resized, (5,5), 0)

    # Median Filter
    median = cv2.medianBlur(resized, 5)

    # Final Pipeline (CLAHE + Gaussian + Normalize)
    final = cv2.GaussianBlur(clahe_img, (5,5), 0) / 255.0

    # Plot
    plt.figure(figsize=(12,8))

    plt.suptitle(f"Processing: {file}")

    plt.subplot(2,3,1)
    plt.imshow(image, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("Original")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(2,3,2)
    plt.imshow(hist_eq, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("Histogram Equalization")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(2,3,3)
    plt.imshow(clahe_img, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("CLAHE")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(2,3,4)
    plt.imshow(gaussian, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("Gaussian Blur")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(2,3,5)
    plt.imshow(median, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("Median Filter")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(2,3,6)
    plt.imshow(final, cmap='gray')
    plt.title("Final Pipeline")
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.show()

In [8]:
def compute_metrics(img):
    mean = np.mean(img)
    std = np.std(img)
    min_val = np.min(img)
    max_val = np.max(img)
    return mean, std, min_val, max_val
In [10]:
results = []

for file in image_files:
    image_path = os.path.join(folder_path, file)
    image = cv2.imread(image_path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)

    if image is None:
        continue

    resized = cv2.resize(image, (256, 256))

    hist_eq = cv2.equalizeHist(resized)

    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8,8))
    clahe_img = clahe.apply(resized)

    gaussian = cv2.GaussianBlur(resized, (5,5), 0)
    median = cv2.medianBlur(resized, 5)
    final = cv2.GaussianBlur(clahe_img, (5,5), 0)

    # compute metrics
    methods = {
        "Original": resized,
        "HistEq": hist_eq,
        "CLAHE": clahe_img,
        "Gaussian": gaussian,
        "Median": median,
        "Final": final
    }

    for name, img in methods.items():
        mean, std, min_val, max_val = compute_metrics(img)
        results.append([file, name, mean, std, min_val, max_val])
